pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. A clear wordless FAMILY TREE with THREE GENERATIONS on pure white. Each person is a small fully visible full-body figure within a thin neutral rounded frame, connected by clear thin family relationship lines. TOP CENTER: one joined frame containing two elderly grandparents side by side, gray hair. MIDDLE ROW: exactly TWO separate adult siblings, adult mother at LEFT and adult aunt at RIGHT. The grandparents frame connects downward to a single horizontal branching line, with a downward branch to EACH of these two adult siblings, making them siblings, not a couple. BOTTOM LEFT: one school-age child in a BLUE outline frame, a direct vertical line ONLY from the LEFT adult to this child, identifying the blue child as the reference person's child. No child below the right adult. RED outline around ONLY the MIDDLE RIGHT adult woman, and a red arrow points precisely to this person. This is the blue child's AUNT, the mother's sister. All other frames gray. No cross-connecting spouse line between middle adults. Clear simple relationship diagram with ample white spacing so connections are unambiguous. Simple whole-body flat figures, reference child in blue, target adult in orange. All complete figures, no text, names, letters, numbers or labels anywhere. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
